note: Starter module templates reverse-engineered from the 2026-27 On-Demand builds. Every template is a DRAFT until a subject lead approves it; the approvedBy field is empty on purpose.

componentTypes.label: Section header
componentTypes.description: A text divider inside a module (Week 3, Unit Assessment).

componentTypes.label: Interactive lesson
componentTypes.description: A GitHub-hosted Optima lesson page embedded in a Canvas assignment. Learn, Explore, Check, Assignment tabs.

componentTypes.label: Reading
componentTypes.description: A chapter, passage, or library title with a short response.

componentTypes.label: Video
componentTypes.description: An Optima video or a Music Library video with a viewing prompt.

componentTypes.label: Assignment
componentTypes.description: Teacher-written task with instructions and a submission box.

componentTypes.label: Discussion
componentTypes.description: A Canvas discussion prompt (council chamber, Socratic seminar, share-out).

componentTypes.label: Quiz / check-in
componentTypes.description: Auto-graded and essay questions exported as a Canvas quiz (QTI).

componentTypes.label: Practice
componentTypes.description: Independent practice, Goblins session, or worksheet.

componentTypes.label: Fluency routine
componentTypes.description: Weekly ELA fluency read with a recording.

componentTypes.label: Unit assessment
componentTypes.description: End-of-unit task page (often paired with a quiz).

componentTypes.label: Module project
componentTypes.description: Capstone, exhibit, or unlock challenge that gathers the unit's evidence.

componentTypes.label: Spotlight task (VR)
componentTypes.description: Placeholder for the weekly Spotlight or Arthur VR investigation.

componentTypes.label: Art from the library
componentTypes.description: An artwork card from the Art Reference Library with looking prompts.

componentTypes.label: Music from the library
componentTypes.description: A listening card from the Music Reference Library.

componentTypes.label: Book from the library
componentTypes.description: A title card from the ELA Reference Library (free or purchase link).

componentTypes.label: Content page
componentTypes.description: A Canvas page: Start Here, Course Guide, teacher notes.

componentTypes.label: My own resource
componentTypes.description: Paste a link, embed code, or your own HTML.

templates.name: ELA Weekly Rhythm
templates.subject: ela
templates.description: Four novel lessons, a fluency read, and a Friday check-in. Repeats every week inside a book unit.

slots.label: Week {n} Check-In

templates.name: Historian-Citizen Unit
templates.subject: social-studies
templates.derivedFrom: 4th Grade Social Studies On-Demand 2026-27 (OAO 3-5 planning table)
templates.description: Lesson A (Enter the Story) and Lesson B (Work of the Historian-Citizen) pairs, then an assessment task and a knowledge-check quiz.

slots.label: Lesson A: Enter the Story
slots.note: Reading, image or map, short video, vocabulary

slots.label: Lesson B: Work of the Historian-Citizen
slots.note: Map Quest, Source Study, Timeline Thread, Council Chamber, Virtue Lens, or Notebook

slots.label: Unit Assessment quiz
slots.note: About 14 items: multiple choice plus evidence essays

templates.name: Dimensions Math Unit
templates.subject: math
templates.description: Interactive lessons with built-in fluency checks, Goblins independent practice, and a summative assessment.

slots.label: Goblins Independent Practice
slots.note: Duplicate the Goblins template and add the class code

templates.name: Project-Based Module
templates.derivedFrom: Team brainstorm 2026-09-01 (module project at the bottom, steps auto-filled)
templates.description: Three teaching steps that feed one visible module project. Pick the project first; the steps fill in from the repo.

slots.label: Module project
slots.note: Exhibit, oral exam, lab report, AI-with-character activity, or VR build

templates.name: Lab Module
templates.subject: science
templates.derivedFrom: Placeholder until the science lead submits requirements
templates.description: Phenomenon video, core lesson, hands-on or virtual lab, and a check.

templates.description: Read, annotate, deliberate, and write. Bloom's ladder climbs from understand to evaluate across the week.
